schema.help: Think only of other people, not of traffic.
schema.text: How safe did you feel from other people (e.g. theft, harassment)?

ar.#How safe did you feel from other people: إلى أي مدى شعرت بالأمان من الأشخاص الآخرين (مثل السرقة أو التحرش)؟
ar.#Think only of other people, not of traf: فكّر في الأشخاص الآخرين فقط، وليس في حركة المرور.

de.#How safe did you feel from other people: Wie sicher haben Sie sich gegenüber anderen Menschen gefühlt (z. B. Diebstahl, Belästigung)?
de.#Think only of other people, not of traf: Denken Sie nur an andere Menschen, nicht an den Verkehr.

en.#How safe did you feel from other people: How safe did you feel from other people (e.g. theft, harassment)?
en.#Think only of other people, not of traf: Think only of other people, not of traffic.

fa.#How safe did you feel from other people: چقدر خود را در برابر افراد دیگر (مثلاً سرقت، مزاحمت) در امان احساس کردید؟
fa.#Think only of other people, not of traf: فقط به افراد دیگر فکر کنید، نه به ترافیک.

fr.#How safe did you feel from other people: À quel point vous sentiez-vous en sécurité vis-à-vis des autres personnes (par ex. vol, harcèlement) ?
fr.#Think only of other people, not of traf: Pensez seulement aux autres personnes, pas à la circulation.

hu.#How safe did you feel from other people: Mennyire érezte magát biztonságban más emberektől (pl. lopás, zaklatás)?
hu.#Think only of other people, not of traf: Csak a többi emberre gondoljon, ne a forgalomra.

it.#How safe did you feel from other people: Quanto ti sentivi al sicuro rispetto ad altre persone (ad es. furti, molestie)?
it.#Think only of other people, not of traf: Pensa solo alle altre persone, non al traffico.

tr.#How safe did you feel from other people: Diğer insanlara karşı kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissettiniz (örn. hırsızlık, taciz)?
tr.#Think only of other people, not of traf: Trafiği değil, yalnızca diğer insanları düşünün.
